title: Release Escape Hatch Sandbox and Cohort Rewind Prototype
creator: Ava Martin
description: Goal: Design an Escape Hatch experience that lets operators quickly pause, rewind, or surgically rewind traffic for cohorts while surfacing the risk and cost impacts. The sandbox should let SREs and PMs rehearse a rollback path using a timeboxed, replay-driven simulator and a cohort-rewind scripting editor. Key outcomes: (1) clear primary action surfaces for emergency vs planned reversions, (2) a compact cohort selector with pinned telemetry snapshots, (3) preflight simulation with latency/error/cost delta, and (4) a minimal scripting UX for advanced rewind actions (time-slice revert, shadow-to-live swap, partial-traffic drains). This ticket captures the prototype flows, design decisions, annotated wireframes, and proposed UX copy for both urgent and non-urgent rollback scenarios.
comments: 2026-02-22 - Ava Martin: Initial discovery: interviewed on-call SREs and two enterprise customers about evacuation patterns. SREs want a 30-second path to fully stop a rollout; PMs want cost/backfill estimates before action.
2026-02-28 - Diego Chen: Wireframes v1 posted. Focused on urgent 'stop' and 'rewind' as distinct lanes. Added a compact cohort selector that supports regex and segment tags.

2026-03-03 - Priya Nair (PM): Feedback: Add a rehearsal mode that uses historical telemetry to simulate the effects of the rewind without committing. Also require a brief justification field for audit logs.
2026-03-05 - Diego Chen: Updated prototype to include preflight simulation with 3 metrics (p90 latency, error rate, cost delta). Added a cost impact badge computed from token-rate heuristics.
2026-03-08 - Security review request: Submitted initial flows to Security for audit-log / RBAC impacts. Note: included KMS-signed decision artifact in scope for Private deployments.

2026-03-11 - Design review session: Stakeholders (SRE, PM, Legal) reviewed microcopy and the confirm modal. Added: 'Rehearse first' suggested default for non-critical rollouts; emergency path still shows a single-step 'Stop and Snapshot' flow.
2026-03-12 - Diego Chen: Prototype updated from session. Marking ticket In Review and requesting engineering feasibility check for telemetry replay service and cost-estimate API.
Suggested follow-ups: A/B test two CTA phrasings in the console ("Stop rollout" vs "Pause and Snapshot"), and measure operator time-to-action in the next on-call rotation.
